items.heading: People Often Ask
items.text: People often ask for a humanities jobs list with a salary next to each role. A single table of numbers for these lanes would be misleading, because pay in content, research, policy, communication and learning design swings widely with the employer type, the city, the seniority and the skill layer you add. A small agency, a large company and a research organisation can pay very differently for the same job title.
